sources: Host-authored illustrative Northstar Advisory planning model
speaker_notes: This is an illustrative planning model for fictional Northstar Advisory. Annual capacity assumes 900 engagements. Research uses 900 x 12 baseline hours x 60% adoption x 30% time saved = 1,944 hours. The same formula produces 1,440 proposal hours and 1,080 retrieval hours from the displayed assumptions.

The three workflow estimates may overlap and cannot be added without checking task boundaries. Capacity released is not a cash saving. Control readiness determines the proposed sequence, and expert review remains required before any client release.
notes: Preserve vertical chart columns, category order, orange first value, and the selected research row. Numeric labels remain linked to chart values.
The assumptions and sequencing tables are separate editable business views. Editing the chart does not recalculate them.
The semantic map owns current geometry and type roles. The inherited frame is added outside the generated content region. Canonical SVGs replace generated icon stand-ins.
